TRIALIQ-101 — Phase II Investigational Study
Participant PT-1042
Multiple screening laboratory values fail protocol thresholds, and multiple baseline criteria lack affirmative source evidence, requiring a hold on eligibility confirmation and immediate resolution of missing documentation.

Participant PT-1042 presents with advanced NSCLC and multiple screening laboratory values outside protocol thresholds, including hemoglobin (10.2 g/dL vs >=12.0 g/dL required), ANC (1.1 x10^9/L vs >=1.5 x10^9/L required), platelets (145 x10^9/L vs >=150 x10^9/L required), creatinine (1.4 mg/dL vs <=1.2 mg/dL required), ALT (82 U/L vs <=45 U/L required), and AST (76 U/L vs <=40 U/L required). Furthermore, several non-laboratory screening criteria lack affirmative source evidence, and a protocol deviation occurred regarding the Day 15 visit window and delayed CBC collection. A Grade 2 nausea and vomiting event began 18 hours post-treatment, leading to a temporary study dose hold.
